sentence: Spend your lazernoon nonchalassionate. The work will still be there.

wombos.definition: Deeply passionate about something but expressing it with total chill and ease — intensely into it without seeming try-hard or desperate. Passionate on the inside, unbothered on the outside.
A slow, unhurried afternoon spent doing little — the peak hours of a lazy day when productivity is fully abandoned.
wombos.example: I spent the whole lazernoon on the porch, not thinking about anything.
